about.zh: 把一张图的背景抠掉，存成透明背景的 PNG（文件名以 nobg 开头）。
about.en: Cuts a picture's background away and saves it as a transparent PNG (prefix nobg).

source.zh: 参考工作流的「背景移除」组，换成你装的 inspyrenet-rembg
source.en: The reference workflow's background removal, with your inspyrenet-rembg

after: run_workflow saves it with the background cut away (transparent PNG, prefix nobg). On a canvas that makes pictures those are made too: to cut this one out alone, add the block on a blank tab (new_workflow).
